newsitem.title: USA: Chip equipment stocks spark rally, boost Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: Chip equipment stocks spark rally, boost Nasdaq.

text.p: A rally in semiconductor equipment stocks spilled over into the broader technology sector, pushing Nasdaq shares up about two percent after a recent slump.

The Nasdaq composite index gained 27.45 points to close unofficially at 1358.96. Nasdaq shares had fallen in six of the previous seven sessions. The Dow industrials surged 103.52 points to close unofficially at 6961.63, its first finish above the 6900 threshold.

Applied Materials Inc's strong first quarter earnings prompted several industry analysts to upgrade the stock and boost estimates. Applied Materials surged seven to 52-1/8, Cisco Systems Inc gained 4-1/16 to 64-5/8 and Intel Corp rose five to 156-3/4.

"The was some much needed optimism in tech stocks today. Some of the buying was semiconductor strength, some of it was bottom-feeders coming along looking for bargains after the selloff," one trader said.
Other winners included Money Store Inc, which gained 5-1/4 to 26-3/8 after posting strong fourth quarter earnings. Overall, gainers beat losers 2438 to 1936 on total volume of 687 million shares.
